metadata.title: Secure Storage High-Assurance SSPP
metadata.remarks: Defines additional constraints, stricter assumptions, and reduced tolerance for drift applicable to high-assurance storage environments. This SSPP tightens secure storage requirements without redefining authority, base behavior, or platform implementation.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP overlays all Secure Storage SSPPs and SHALL only tighten, never weaken, their requirements.

pattern-bindings.remarks: Applies high-assurance constraints across all secure storage patterns, including confidentiality, access, integrity, lifecycle, and telemetry.

system-characteristics.system-description: High-assurance storage environments supporting regulated, safety-critical, research-critical, or evidentiary workloads.

props.name: storage-assurance-tier
props.remarks: Indicates this storage system operates under the highest institutional assurance tier.

props.name: drift-tolerance
props.remarks: Configuration drift is not an acceptable steady state and must escalate immediately.

props.name: immutability-requirement
props.remarks: Immutability is required for all designated data classes without exception.

props.name: encryption-exception-policy
props.remarks: No cryptographic protection exceptions are permitted in high-assurance storage.

props.name: deletion-authority
props.remarks: Irreversible data destruction requires explicit governance authorization in all cases.

props.name: audit-evidence-grade
props.remarks: All telemetry and audit records must be suitable for forensic and legal use.

system-implementation.remarks: High-assurance secure storage SHALL operate with reduced tolerance for ambiguity, failure, and operational exception. All enforcement mechanisms SHALL favor preservation, evidence retention, and escalation.

roles.title: High-Assurance Secure Storage Oversight
roles.remarks: Ensures that high-assurance storage systems operate within the narrowest acceptable risk envelope.

roles.title: High-Assurance Secure Storage Assurance
roles.remarks: Verifies continuous compliance, evidentiary integrity, and enforcement consistency in high-assurance storage.

high-assurance-requirements.statement: Any detected deviation from approved secure storage configuration SHALL trigger immediate escalation without grace period.
Data designated as high-assurance SHALL be stored under immutable controls for the full retention period.
All storage telemetry SHALL be retained and protected at forensic evidence grade.

prohibited-high-assurance-actions.statement: Operational urgency SHALL NOT justify deviation from high-assurance storage requirements.
Temporary suspension or softening of secure storage controls SHALL NOT be permitted.

escalation-requirements.statement: All high-assurance storage violations SHALL escalate directly to governance and SecOps.

control-implementation.description: High-assurance overlay tightens control expectations for cryptographic protection, integrity, auditability, and governance.

implemented-requirements.remarks: High-assurance supply chain and platform trust assumptions are enforced.
Audit records are retained for extended periods suitable for legal investigation.
Recovery and preservation mechanisms are assured at the highest level.

statements.statement: High-assurance storage SHALL favor preservation and evidence over availability.
Uncertainty in high-assurance storage SHALL escalate, not defer.
No exceptions are implied by operational pressure.

back-matter.remarks: This SSPP establishes the highest secure storage assurance tier. Environment overlays such as IT, OT, or IoMT MAY further constrain behavior but SHALL NOT weaken these requirements.
